items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Bullmoose Jackson was in that saxophone section.

ctx.x: Bullmoose Jackson was in that saxophone section. Billy Mitchell was in that saxophone section. But I can't think of the rhythm section. I just can't think of them. There was two brothers, one a pianist and one a bass player. And the one that was a bass player turned out to be an organist around Detroit. And the drummer I forget. I've seen the drummer around now, every now and then, and I forget his name, too.
